title: Counter
subtitle: 本課限定語境：counter in a shop / service setting · 「櫃檯／服務台／收銀台」
description: 本課限定語境：counter in a shop / service setting · 「櫃檯／服務台／收銀台」

words.note: 當 counter 的主要功能是讓顧客付款、結帳時非常自然。
words.example: Please take your items to the checkout desk.
words.exampleZh: 請把商品帶到結帳櫃檯。

exercises.original: Please take your items to the counter to pay.
exercises.zh: 請把商品帶到結帳櫃檯付款。
exercises.upgrade: Please take your items to the checkout desk to pay.

options.explanation: items + to pay 直接指出零售結帳功能。
通常處理查詢、退貨，不一定付款。
是收銀設備，不是完整服務位置。

exercises.original: There was a queue at the counter where customers paid for their purchases.
exercises.zh: 顧客付款的結帳櫃檯前排了長隊。
exercises.upgrade: There was a queue at the checkout desk.

options.explanation: 通常處理售後服務，不是一般付款。
太泛，沒有明確 checkout 功能。
可表示結帳流程／區域，但此句需要明確服務點名詞。

exercises.original: The shop opened another counter because too many people were waiting to pay.
exercises.zh: 商店因太多人等候付款而多開一個結帳櫃檯。
exercises.upgrade: The shop opened another checkout desk.

options.explanation: waiting to pay 是關鍵線索。
表示收銀工作／操作，不是櫃檯。

words.note: 和 checkout desk 非常接近，但更直接保留 counter 的實體櫃檯感。
words.example: There was a long queue at the checkout counter.

exercises.original: A long line had formed at the counter near the store exit.
exercises.zh: 商店出口附近的結帳櫃檯排了長隊。
exercises.upgrade: A long line had formed at the checkout counter.

options.explanation: 商店出口＋排隊，典型結帳位置。
不合零售出口付款功能。
也可能接近，但更強調收銀員工作位；本句是顧客排隊的櫃檯。

exercises.original: She placed the basket on the counter before paying.
exercises.zh: 她付款前把購物籃放在結帳櫃檯上。
exercises.upgrade: She placed the basket on the checkout counter before paying.

options.explanation: 通常不是一般商品掃描付款位置。
通常指收銀機，而不是整個檯面。

exercises.original: Impulse-buy items are often displayed beside the counter where payment is made.
exercises.zh: 衝動購物商品常擺放在付款櫃檯旁。
exercises.upgrade: Impulse-buy items are often displayed beside the checkout counter.

options.explanation: 零售陳列＋付款點是典型搭配。

words.meaning: 收銀員工作台；收銀櫃位
words.note: 指收銀員工作的結帳位置。
words.example: Only two cashier stations were open.
words.exampleZh: 只有兩個收銀櫃位開放。

exercises.original: Only two counters with cashiers were open during the quiet period.
exercises.zh: 較清閒時段只有兩個收銀櫃位開放。
exercises.upgrade: Only two cashier stations were open.

options.explanation: 重點是「有收銀員工作的獨立櫃位」。
也很接近，但更強調顧客結帳檯面；station 更突出工作位置數量。

exercises.original: The manager assigned one employee to each counter used for taking payments.
exercises.zh: 經理在每個收銀工作站安排一名員工。
exercises.upgrade: The manager assigned one employee to each cashier station.

options.explanation: assigned one employee to each 強調工作站。
也可能是付款位置，但 station 更適合「每個員工一個位置」。

exercises.original: The supermarket added four new payment counters, each with its own scanner and till.
exercises.zh: 超市增加四個新的收銀櫃位，每個都有掃描器和收銀機。
exercises.upgrade: The supermarket added four new cashier stations.

options.explanation: scanner + till + 独立付款工作位非常吻合。

words.note: 當 counter 用來回答問題、處理查詢、退換貨或提供協助時最自然。
words.example: Ask at the service desk if you need help.
words.exampleZh: 如需協助，請到服務台查詢。

exercises.original: Ask at the counter if you need help finding a product.
exercises.zh: 如需協助尋找商品，請到服務台查詢。
exercises.upgrade: Ask at the service desk if you need help.

options.explanation: 一般查詢／協助功能最自然。
抽象名詞，不能代替地點。

exercises.original: The counter handles questions about store policies and lost property.
exercises.zh: 這個服務台處理商店政策和失物查詢。
exercises.upgrade: The service desk handles questions about store policies and lost property.

options.explanation: questions + lost property 是顧客服務功能。
不是這個意思；serving counter 通常供餐。

exercises.original: Passengers with problems should go to the airline counter for assistance.
exercises.zh: 有問題的乘客應到航空公司服務台求助。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers with problems should go to the airline service desk for assistance.

options.explanation: 句子重點是 problem assistance，而不是辦理登機。
主要辦理報到／行李手續。
機場不通常稱航空公司櫃位為 reception desk。

words.meaning: 顧客服務台；客戶服務櫃檯
words.note: 比 service desk 更明確表示專門處理顧客服務。
words.example: Returns are handled at the customer service desk.
words.exampleZh: 退貨在顧客服務台處理。

exercises.original: Returns are handled at the counter near the entrance.
exercises.zh: 退貨在入口附近的顧客服務台處理。
exercises.upgrade: Returns are handled at the customer service desk.

options.explanation: returns 是最典型功能之一。
表示服務活動，不是櫃檯。

exercises.original: Customers can make complaints at the counter on the ground floor.
exercises.zh: 顧客可在地下的顧客服務台提出投訴。
exercises.upgrade: Customers can make complaints at the customer service desk.

options.explanation: complaints 是明確顧客服務功能。
雖可接待查詢，但零售 complaint 更常 customer service desk。

exercises.original: The store moved exchanges and refunds to a separate counter.
exercises.zh: 商店把換貨和退款轉到獨立的顧客服務台處理。
exercises.upgrade: The store moved exchanges and refunds to a separate customer service desk.

options.explanation: exchanges + refunds 是售後服務核心功能。
一般付款，不是專門售後。

words.note: 當 counter 位於酒店、辦公室、診所等，用來接待訪客時最自然。
words.example: Please leave your key at the reception desk.
words.exampleZh: 請把鑰匙留在接待櫃檯。

exercises.original: Hotel guests should leave their room keys at the counter.
exercises.zh: 酒店住客應把房間鑰匙留在接待櫃檯。
exercises.upgrade: Hotel guests should leave their room keys at the reception desk.

options.explanation: 酒店接待櫃檯的典型功能。
容易誤解成零售結帳；酒店「check out」不是通常稱 checkout desk。

exercises.original: Visitors must sign in at the counter before entering the office.
exercises.zh: 訪客進入辦公室前必須在接待處登記。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors must sign in at the reception desk.

options.explanation: 辦公室訪客 sign in 的標準位置。
也有登記意思，但更常見於機場／活動／酒店流程。
可查詢，但不如 reception 精確。
可指接待區，但本題要求具體 desk。

exercises.original: The clinic asked patients to report to the counter on arrival.
exercises.zh: 診所要求病人到達時先到接待櫃檯報到。
exercises.upgrade: The clinic asked patients to report to the reception desk on arrival.

options.explanation: 有時可理解，但標準說法是 reception desk。

words.meaning: 登記櫃檯；辦理手續櫃檯
words.note: 在機場、酒店、活動場地等處，指辦理登記／報到手續的櫃檯。
words.example: Passengers should arrive at the check-in desk two hours before departure.
words.exampleZh: 乘客應在起飛前兩小時到登機手續櫃檯。

exercises.original: Passengers should go to the counter to receive their boarding passes.
exercises.zh: 乘客應到登機手續櫃檯領取登機證。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers should go to the check-in desk to receive their boarding passes.

options.explanation: boarding passes + airport 是典型 check-in 功能。
可能處理出票，但辦理登機更精確是 check-in desk。

exercises.original: The airline counter opens three hours before departure.
exercises.zh: 航空公司的登機手續櫃檯在起飛前三小時開放。
exercises.upgrade: The airline check-in desk opens three hours before departure.

options.explanation: 與 departure time 直接相關。
可較長時間營業，功能主要票務。
可指流程，但這裡需要具體地點名詞。

exercises.original: Guests collected their event badges from the registration counter.
exercises.zh: 賓客在報到櫃檯領取活動證件。
exercises.upgrade: Guests collected their badges from the check-in desk.

options.explanation: 活動報到／領證件語境可自然使用。
問題處理，不是一般報到。

words.note: 指購買、領取或處理票務的櫃檯。
words.example: We bought our tickets at the ticket counter.

exercises.original: We bought our train tickets at the counter.
exercises.zh: 我們在售票櫃檯買火車票。
exercises.upgrade: We bought our train tickets at the ticket counter.

options.explanation: 可能處理查詢，不一定售票。

exercises.original: The counter for buying cinema tickets was closed.
exercises.zh: 電影院售票櫃檯關閉了。
exercises.upgrade: The ticket counter was closed.

options.explanation: 可以有收銀員，但沒有明確售票語義。

exercises.original: Visitors can collect prepaid admission passes at the counter by the entrance.
exercises.zh: 訪客可在入口旁的售票櫃檯領取預付入場票。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors can collect prepaid passes at the ticket counter.

words.note: 和 ticket counter 很接近。
words.example: The ticket desk closes at 8 p.m.

exercises.original: The counter that handles ticket changes closes at 8 p.m.
exercises.zh: 處理改票的票務服務台晚上八時關閉。
exercises.upgrade: The ticket desk closes at 8 p.m.

options.explanation: ticket changes 比單純售票更有「票務服務台」感。
太泛，沒有 ticket 功能。

exercises.original: Please ask at the counter if you need to rebook your train ticket.
exercises.zh: 如需重新預訂火車票，請到票務服務台查詢。
exercises.upgrade: Please ask at the ticket desk if you need to rebook.

options.explanation: 也很接近，但較強調售票櫃檯；desk 更有綜合票務服務感。

exercises.original: The station moved refunds to a separate ticket counter for customer assistance.
exercises.zh: 車站把退款服務移到獨立票務服務台。
exercises.upgrade: The station moved refunds to a separate ticket desk.

words.note: 較廣泛、正式，指提供某種服務的櫃檯。
words.example: Customers can collect repaired items at the service counter.
words.exampleZh: 顧客可在服務櫃檯領取已維修物品。

exercises.original: Customers can collect repaired items at the counter.
exercises.zh: 顧客可在服務櫃檯領取已維修物品。
exercises.upgrade: Customers can collect repaired items at the service counter.

options.explanation: 維修後領取是專門服務櫃檯功能。
維修／服務活動，不是地點。

exercises.original: The electronics store has a counter for repairs and technical help.
exercises.zh: 電子產品店設有維修和技術支援服務櫃檯。
exercises.upgrade: The electronics store has a service counter for repairs and technical help.

options.explanation: repairs + technical help 是明確服務功能。

exercises.original: Please take the faulty device to the counter at the back of the store.
exercises.zh: 請把故障設備帶到店後方的服務櫃檯。
exercises.upgrade: Please take the faulty device to the service counter.

options.explanation: 實體維修／技術服務櫃檯很適合。
也接近，但若實際提供技術服務／收件，service counter 更具體。
表示「被服務過的櫃檯」，詞義錯誤。

words.note: 在銀行語境中，表示銀行職員辦理存款、提款等業務的位置。
words.example: She deposited the cheque at the teller counter.
words.exampleZh: 她在銀行櫃檯存入支票。

exercises.original: She deposited the cheque at the bank counter.
exercises.zh: 她在銀行櫃檯存入支票。
exercises.upgrade: She deposited the cheque at the teller counter.

options.explanation: deposit + bank 是銀行櫃員服務。
銀行亦可能有 general service desk，但存支票更精確是 teller counter。

exercises.original: The customer withdrew cash at the counter inside the bank.
exercises.zh: 顧客在銀行櫃檯提款。
exercises.upgrade: The customer withdrew cash at the teller counter.

exercises.original: Only one bank counter was open for cash transactions.
exercises.zh: 只有一個銀行櫃檯開放辦理現金交易。
exercises.upgrade: Only one teller counter was open for cash transactions.

options.explanation: 可能處理賬戶查詢，但未必現金交易。

words.note: 當 counter 用來展示、供應或領取食物時自然。
words.example: Please collect your meal from the serving counter.

exercises.original: Please collect your meal from the counter when your number is called.
exercises.zh: 叫到號碼時，請到供餐櫃檯取餐。
exercises.upgrade: Please collect your meal from the serving counter.

options.explanation: meal collection 是典型供餐櫃檯。

exercises.original: Hot dishes are displayed behind the cafeteria counter.
exercises.zh: 熱食陳列在自助餐廳供餐櫃檯後方。
exercises.upgrade: Hot dishes are displayed behind the serving counter.

options.explanation: 活動／分發行為，不是地點。

exercises.original: Customers order sandwiches at one counter and pay at another.
exercises.zh: 顧客在一個供餐櫃檯點三文治，再到另一個櫃檯付款。
exercises.upgrade: Customers order sandwiches at the serving counter and pay at the checkout counter.

options.explanation: 第一個 counter 用於點餐／供餐。
題目明確說付款是在另一個 counter。

falseSynonyms.zh: 收銀員 ≠ 收銀櫃檯 cashier 是人； counter / checkout desk 是地點或設施。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The cashier is standing behind the checkout counter.

falseSynonyms.zh: 收銀機 ≠ 櫃檯 cash register 是設備，通常放在 checkout counter 上。
桌子／服務台 ≠ 所有 counter desk 可以是辦公桌，也可以是服務台。 只有特定搭配如 reception desk、service desk 才接近此義。
桌子 ≠ 櫃檯 table 通常是獨立家具，不一定用於顧客服務交易。
小亭／窗口 ≠ 所有櫃檯 ticket booth 可以售票，但 booth 更強調封閉／半封閉的小空間。
收銀機／登記 ≠ 櫃檯 在零售語境，register 常指 cash register，而不是整個櫃檯。
詞形陷阱 - service = 名詞／修飾語，服務 - serving = 供應、分發 - serviced = 已接受服務／維修的 service counter 和 serving counter 意思不同。
功能不同 - checkout = 結帳 - check-in = 登記／報到 兩者都可以是 counter/desk，但功能完全不同。
